title: Owner's dashboard approval of one local plan (aiworks-local-approval/1)
description: The record the dashboard writes when the owner approves a plan for a project without GitHub (docs/design/WORK_ENVELOPE.md section 8.4, decision D4, slice E11). It binds the exact plan (declarationDigest = authorityDigest of the declaration), the project, its confirmed rules (overlayDigest) and the code revision. There is no signing key. It is private installation data: it lives in the supervisor store, never in a source branch or pull request. This schema checks the shape only; src/supervisor/local-admission.mjs checks the receipt, the nonce, the ledger, the dates and the digests.
